title: Weight on Mars is roughly one-third of weight on Earth
summary: NASA Glenn says, roughly, that weight on Mars is one-third of weight on Earth.
body: In the beginners' weight guide, updated 20 November 2023, NASA Glenn gives a rough comparison: weight on Mars is one-third of weight on Earth. The same sentence also names a lunar fraction, which is filed on a NASA Science card and is not repeated as this claim. A fact sheet's metres-per-second-squared row for Mars is a different card.

sources.title: Weight Equation
sources.author: Nancy Hall, NASA Glenn Research Center
sources.note: Public-domain NASA Glenn page, last updated 20 November 2023. Paraphrase of the sentence that weight on Mars is roughly 1/3 of weight on Earth, and that mass stays the same.
